headline: Exchanges Flipped To A 252.0 Million Dollar Outflow As Binance Shed 250.3 Million
narrative: Exchanges shed 252.0 million dollars over 24 hours, 0.094 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, reversing a 232.5 million dollar intake at 0.0866 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a negative print means money left the place where holders can sell, and Binance shed 250.3 million dollars after taking in 369.9 million. OKX shed 92.1 million dollars and Bitget shed 52.8 million, while Deribit took in 79.2 million.
author: jordan
